        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = in.nextLine();
        int count = 1;
        int insert = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (i + 1 < s.length() && s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(i + 1)) {
                count++;
            } else {
                if (count % 2 == 0) {
                    insert++;
                }
                count = 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(insert);
    }
